goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann BIP, HDI und ökologische Indikatoren unterscheiden und interpretieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three large labelled lenses contrast production/economic output (BIP), education and health as selected human-development dimensions (HDI), and environmental indicators (Umwelt) over one common town. They contain no invented numerical values or false index formulas. The image illustrates differing perspectives rather than claiming mutually exclusive or exhaustive index components.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px BIP, HDI and Umwelt headings, production arm, book/health and leaf/water symbols remain recognizable. The observer provides a clear common comparison perspective; background micro-details are not needed.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the common town and the selected detailed production, school, health and ecosystem scenes are clear.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The school learner faces an open blank notebook correctly and the health encounter faces both participants; no legible page is upside down for an actor.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: HDI also includes an income dimension. The book/health icons here are selected examples, not an exhaustive definition; the separately reviewed text and teaching evidence must define the full index.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
